items.title: SoftBank pours $200M into Gravis Robotics, valuing the construction-automation startup at $1B
items.note: Largest-ever Series A for a construction robotics startup, retrofits excavators from JCB, Caterpillar and Hitachi with self-driving AI

items.title: AI inference chipmaker Etched raises $700M at $21B, more than doubling its valuation in a month
items.note: Jane Street became its first customer after testing Etched's chip in its own data center

items.title: Cursor launches Origin, a GitHub rival for AI-native code hosting
items.note: Capitalizes on developer frustration with GitHub to host repos, PRs and collaborative coding work

items.title: CodeRabbit raises $143M Series C at $1.5B, launches Agentic Change Management
items.note: Runs 2M+ code reviews a week for 17,000+ customers including Nvidia and BMW, revenue up 5x year over year

items.title: July housing starts sink 12.4% even as building permits climb 5%
items.note: Builders keep planning ahead but pausing execution as mortgage rates and construction costs bite

items.title: DoiT acquires Israeli AI FinOps startup Attribute for an estimated $65M
items.note: Fifth acquisition for DoiT, adds real-time AI and cloud spend tracking as it eyes a $5B AWS resale goal

items.title: Xpander raises $7.5M seed to build the control layer for enterprise AI agents
items.note: Founded by ex-AWS engineers, backed by Pico Venture Partners, Samsung Next and SeedIL
